title: ACIMA Adoption Decisions
description: Owner-authored answers produced by the adoption report or recorded from conversation. A decisions file is intent, not approval: ingestion validates and records it, and the workflow's approval command remains the only way to authorize implementation.

reportId.description: The exact report these answers belong to. A different report id is a stale file.

reportSha256.description: Generation digest of the report the owner reviewed. Optional: a report page cannot hash its own bytes, so the workflow completes this after checking the report on disk.

decisionSha256.description: Digest of the report's decision content, which progress refreshes never change. Optional; completed by the workflow when absent.

proposalSha256.description: Digest of the adoption proposal the report was generated from. Optional; completed by the workflow when absent.

page.description: Which report page produced a partial file. Several partial files are merged by the workflow.

package.description: How the owner reached the selection. Metadata only: answers still list every included path.

supersedes.description: The sha256 of the decisions file this one replaces. Conflicting answers without it are refused.
